description: Election Commission - Mr. B. Yackappillai of the Nanattan Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha - Mrs. S. Tneepan of the Point Pedro Urban Council has Vacated her Office of member of that Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government bodies (Point Pedro Urban Council and Nanattan Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in their respective political parties. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7).
